name: user-management
description: Members + invites + roles-admin surface (P1–P3): UserManagementPanel tabs Members + Roles. Member table, InviteDialog + PendingInvites, RolesPanel (create/edit custom roles via permission matrix). All permission-gated. Props-driven + RBAC-agnostic; pair with rbac-roles + convex-auth.
notes: 0.3.0 (2026-05-31): P3 — roles admin (UserManagementPanel tabs; RolesPanel + RoleEditor + RolePermissionGrid create/edit/delete custom roles, system roles read-only). Roles CRUD reuses rbac-roles' listRoles/upsertRole/removeRole — no new convex here. 0.2.0: invite flow (um_invites). 0.1.0: members table. RBAC-agnostic by design — the slice imports no other slice's frontend; roles + resolved permissions + permission catalog are passed as props (wire from rbac-roles at the app level). Full-parity extras (P4: hierarchy/teams/access-matrix) follow.
